items.basis: The candidate claims removal of "scale particles above 120 microns" and an 8x reduction in blockages from particles "above 200 microns," but wedge-wire screens have a nominal slot rating that does not guarantee absolute retention at that dimension; elongated scale slivers below 120 microns in thickness but exceeding 200 microns in length will pass the second stage and bridge nozzle orifices, undermining the stated mechanism. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "a two-stage wedge-wire cascade (300 then 120 micron) on the header supply removes scale particles above 120 microns before they reach the nozzles"

The candidate explicitly bounds the intervention to scale-particle clogging only, declares biofilm out of scope, and constrains pressure to 13-15 bar, all of which are internally consistent with the stated problem boundary conditions. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "the intervention explicitly targets SCALE-PARTICLE clogging only — biofilm clogging is declared OUT OF SCOPE"

The candidate asserts "removed-nozzle analysis over two campaigns shows scale-particle blockages reduced 8x" as a testable prediction while simultaneously holding an evidence bundle of "(none held)"; stating that an analysis "shows" a specific quantitative outcome requires data, making this a direct contradiction between the claimed evidentiary result and the empty evidence record. GROUNDED_IN: EVIDENCE (none held) | RECORD "removed-nozzle analysis over two campaigns shows scale-particle blockages reduced 8x while biofilm blockage counts are statistically unchanged"

items.basis: The candidate computes a reduction in total campaign clogging events from 4.1 to approximately 3.3, demonstrating a quantified departure from the status quo baseline rather than equivalence to it. GROUNDED_IN: COMPUTATION 4.1 baseline events minus 3.3 predicted events equals 0.8 events removed per campaign

The candidate specifies installation via "flanged spool swap during planned roll change" for a device "sized for full design flow" on a "150 mm header supply" without providing dimensions or weight; a full-flow two-stage cascade with automatic backflush valves on a 150 mm line may exceed the spatial envelope available between existing flanges during a standard roll change window. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "no mill stop for installation (flanged spool swap during planned roll change)" | RECORD "sized for full design flow"

The testable prediction relies on "removed-nozzle analysis" to distinguish "scale-particle blockages" from "biofilm blockage counts," but provides no analytical protocol (e.g., microscopy, chemical dissolution) to definitively classify mixed deposits where scale nuclei are embedded within biological matrices. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "removed-nozzle analysis over two campaigns shows scale-particle blockages reduced 8x while biofilm blockage counts are statistically unchanged"
